routes.acquisitionSummary: Current official ALDI TALK pages: Starter-Set is €9.99 incl. €10 starting credit. Official activity-window PDF valid from 2026-01-01: initial active window 12 months; each top-up starts a new window (€5 → 4 months, €10 → 8, €15 → 12, €30 → 24), followed by 2 months passive reachability.

keep.action: €5 top-up every 4 months (official ladder) ≈ €15/yr; or larger top-up for longer window. After window lapse, 2-month passive grace before deactivation.

routes.chinaActivation: Registration requires personal data and identity verification. Official ALDI TALK supports online Video-Ident or in-person POSTIDENT/Shop-Ident; China-first completion with a foreign passport remains unverified.
routes.kyc: Mandatory identity verification with an accepted valid ID; passport may qualify depending on document/security features.
routes.payment: Aldi store vouchers (cash) or bank/card online.
routes.roamingSms: Receiving SMS abroad generally works; EU-roaming focused tariff, China receiving unverified — 验证中.
routes.refund: Official PDF: remaining credit refundable on deactivation (on request).
guideSteps: Acquire the €9.99 starter set and complete identity verification.
€5 top-up every ~110 days, or use a larger official top-up for a longer activity window.

routes.acquisitionSummary: Current Vodafone help confirms CallYa is unlimited-duration but may be terminated after more than 90 days without use; Vodafone sends an SMS first and gives 4 weeks to object before blocking. Current CallYa Classic has no basic fee; SIM/eSIM activation and physical-SIM shipping are free.

keep.action: Conservative remote keep-alive model: €5 direct online top-up at least every 90 days (≈€20/year). Current specialist guidance says a user-initiated paid call, SMS or mobile-data use can also count as activity, but the cheapest China-roaming action cost is not yet verified. 90-day inactivity can trigger a warning SMS, then a 4-week objection window before block.

routes.chinaActivation: Official CallYa registration supports online AutoID/eID/Video-Chat and eSIM delivery by email; registration requires name, address and date of birth. China-first success with a Chinese passport remains unverified and document-dependent.
routes.kyc: Mandatory prepaid identity verification; online or Postfiliale methods are available, with accepted method depending on ID document.
routes.roamingSms: Receiving abroad works; China rates 验证中.
routes.holdReason: Strictest major-market window found (90 days) + Germany KYC barrier; document as reference, not recommendation.
routes.tariffSummary: No-base-fee CallYa Classic; >90 days inactivity can trigger cancellation warning, with 4 weeks to object.
guideSteps: Order the free CallYa Classic SIM/eSIM and complete identity verification.
Use the conservative €5 direct online top-up path at least every 90 days; cheaper paid usage may count, but China-roaming action cost is still unverified.

routes.acquisitionSummary: Current official Hotlink Pantas pages: starter pack RM10 with RM5 credit; the 365-day Active Period Pass costs RM30 and keeps the account/SIM active for 365 days. Separate 365-day internet passes include 1GB/RM2, but those do not keep an inactive SIM active.

keep.action: Current Hotlink FAQ: buy the RM30 365-day Active Period Pass in the Hotlink app to keep the account/SIM active for 365 days. The RM2/365-day product is a 1GB data pass and is not a keep-alive substitute.
